newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips erase session losses, techs mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips erase session losses, techs mixed.

text.p: The Dow industrials pulled higher after languishing at negative levels in early afternoon trading on Thursday, while the technology stocks also steadied above session lows.
The broader stock market drifted as investors rotated holdings while focusing on corporate earnings, analysts said.
"The market is fairly well balanced," Alice Hook, first vice president and trader at McDonald & Co, said. "For all the buyers, we've seen some profit-takers."
The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained around 26 points to 7869, after rising then drifting lower in the morning.
The Nasdaq composite was off 0.30 points at 1486, well above intraday lows.
Reasonably strong comparable store sales results from retailers and in-line earnings results gave the stock market support, Hook said.
